attributes.board_name: South Carolina Board of Medical Examiners (SC LLR)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Category 1 by AMA (ACCME), AOA (AOACCME), AAPA or another Board-approved organization; remaining 50 may be Category 1 or AMA-defined Category 2
rules.alternatives: Current NCCPA certification establishes compliance, except the controlled substance prescribing hours (and the human trafficking course).
rules.audit_note: Keep proof at least 3 years after renewal; the Board may run random audits.

topics.who: PAs with controlled substance prescriptive authority: prescribing and monitoring Schedule II-IV drugs every two years (S.C. Code §40-47-965(B)(2))
All PAs: Board-approved course before Jan 1, 2028 (licensed before 2026) or within 2 years of initial licensure, then every 6 years (S.C. Code §40-47-953)

rules.notes: PA license renews biennially (S.C. Code §40-47-1010); renewal fee capped by statute at $150. LLR site timed out, so facts are from the Code of Regulations and the S.C. Code.
rules.rule_quote: The continued professional competency of a physician assistant holding a South Carolina license that renews biennially must be demonstrated in the following manner: (A) One hundred (100) CME credits, including no less than 50 Category 1 CME credits.
